settings.heading: About Us
settings.fallback_content:
Deshal Limited is a progressive fashion and lifestyle company from Bangladesh. Our work is rooted in fine arts, artisanal heritage, and tradition, brought into contemporary fashion, lifestyle, and home décor.

For almost two decades, Deshal has worked with handcrafted, native, and indigenous products. Today, more than 200 rural artisans and producers contribute to a close-knit creative community focused on making thoughtful products that are comfortable, durable, and affordable.
